alpha_rule.operation: decrease to min(original alpha, registered generated alpha); no increases. Manually reviewed hair neutral-white components in the two narrow behind-hair ROIs are set to alpha0, including generated-hair overlap. Face/outfit excluded.
alpha_rule.manual_hair_review_basis: Native original and generated reference enlarged comparison; clear original background in brown-hair gaps; source RGB threshold and component seeds unchanged; face, arm, ivory and warm hair pixels excluded

rgb_rule.band: Chebyshev radius3 around original alpha<16 or approved alpha mask
rgb_rule.crown_mixed_halo: One-pixel Chebyshev neighbours of strict-white pixels, still minRGB>=135/range<=75 and local material/luma safety gates

final_art_approval: NOT_RECORDED; technical integration of the existing pilot only
